mentions.name: Halal Code Check
mentions.description: This web app scans product labels to identify the status of E-Codes (food additive codes). It is an offline-first app offering image scanning, image upload, and E-code database search through voice and typing. It is currently in beta, with barcode scanning and other features planned.
